verses.2366: waḥaṣṣil dawāmā madḥa nukhbahi hāshimi tanīʾālu lladhī tabghī mina l-fatḥi wal-yusri
verses.2367: bihi fāstaghli yā ʿabdu mā dumta qādirā famadḥu rasūli llāhi min ʾaʿẓami dh-dhukhri
verses.2368: bihi nāla mā nāla r-rijālu marātibā mina l-maliki l-ʿallāmi jallat ʿani l-ḥaṣri
verses.2369: famadḥu rasūli llāhi ʾaḥmada ʿuddatī maḥabbatuhu fī l-qalbi kā n-nafshi fī ṣ-ṣakhri
verses.2370: ʾayā man baʿa l-khayrāti yā sayyida l-warā wakhātima naẓmi l-ʾanbiyāʾi dhawī l-qadri
verses.2371: fahā naḥnu ʿinda l-bābi yā sayyida l-warā bijāhikumu narjū sh-shafāʿata fī l-ḥashri
verses.2372: walaysa lanā fī l-yawmi wal-ghadi munqidu siwā jāhikum fī ḥālati ṣ-ṣīqi wal-ʿusri
verses.2373: ʾataynāka maghmū mīn rājīna kashafa mā ladaynā mina l-ʾaḥzāni wal-karbi waḍ-ḍayri
verses.2374: ʾayā munqidha l-gharqā jamīʿā faʾinnani ʿarīqu faʾanqidhnī min ʾahwāli dhā d-dahri
verses.2375: faʾanta lanā riknu qawiyyu wamafzaʿu ʾidhā shtadda ti l-ʾahwāli fī s-sirri wal-jahri
verses.2376: ʾaghithnā falaysa l-ḥālu yakhfā ʿalaykumu ghiyātha l-warā l-hādī ʾilā subli l-khayri
verses.2377: ʾilahiyā fārḥam wāʿfu wāstur tafaḍḍula biʾafḍali l-mabghūthi ʾilā l-khalqi dhī l-fakhri
verses.2378: ʾamawlāyā yā dhā l-faḍli jūdika dallanī ʿalayka fajud bil-ʿafwi yā wāsiʿa s-sitri
verses.2379: madadnā ʾakuffa s-sūli rājīna minkumu jamīʿa lladhī nabghī mina l-ʿizzi wan-naṣri
verses.2380: wabābuka mā wāfāhu ʿabdu walam yanal bijūdi ka mā yarjū mina l-fawzi wal-ʾajri
verses.2381: ṣalātu wataslīmu ʿalā sh-shāfiʿi l-warā muḥammādi l-mukhtāri khayri bannī fiʿri
verses.2382: waʾazwājihi wal-ʾāli ʾanjum dīnihi waʾaṣḥā bihi murdī ṭ-ṭughāti dhawī l-kufri
